subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation activate the full sanitized models.providers.xai.request transport contract through useConfiguredRequest, with browser policy retaining the shared caller-precedence behavior?
rationale: The fix reuses an established contract and avoids plugin-local policy duplication, but it also activates headers, auth, proxy, TLS, and private-network behavior on a security-sensitive surface that previously ignored the request block.

options.title: Approve the canonical request path
options.body: Keep useConfiguredRequest, require current-head guarded-path proof and focused precedence coverage, then merge after provider/security owner review.

options.title: Limit the authorization scope
options.body: Remove full configured-request activation and support only the browser SSRF policy, accepting that models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork remains ineffective for image generation.

options.title: Pause the private-network change
options.body: Leave xAI image generation fail-closed until maintainers define a narrower endpoint-scoped trust contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the canonical request path
recommendation.body: Keep useConfiguredRequest, require current-head guarded-path proof and focused precedence coverage, then merge after provider/security owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest recent history on the shared SSRF and provider-request policy boundary that determines the safe authorization contract.
